extracted.name: Spicy Watermelon
extracted.description: Spicy watermelon is a summertime favorite that's easy to make by tossing watermelon cubes with plenty of cumin, coriander, and chili powder.
instruction_lines: Mix cumin, coriander, chili powder, salt, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl.
Place watermelon into serving bowls; sprinkle with spice mixture. Squeeze lime juice over spiced watermelon.
